name: Build Zoop
author: tidic84
description: Satisfactory-style building for StellarDrive Demo. Hold V to choose horizontal or vertical lines, diagonals, rectangular areas, 45-degree areas with straight triangle edges, or slope-corner triangles. Preview up to 10,000 parts and place them with one zoop; occupied spots and missing materials are highlighted and skipped. Supports slopes, diagonal walls, recycling and undo, plus middle-click pick, placement nudging, rotation lock and circuit copy. Compatible interior panels can share a voxel. Requires SDModKit. Replaces Build Plus.
